lessons.whatWorked: Building the tool against REAL .ai/ and audit/eais/ files from the start (never mocked) meant the first real run immediately validated the whole read path end-to-end.
lessons.whatFailed: Two build failures (missing @types/node, wrong dist/ path in the npm script) and one logic bug (stopword false-positive) were all found by actually running the tool, not by review.
lessons.rootCause: TS7's stricter/different default global-type resolution vs assumptions carried over from the root project's Astro-provided type setup; dist/ output path assumption didn't account for rootDir:'.' preserving src/ and tests/ subfolders.
lessons.recurrencePrevention: README.md documents the dist/src/cli.js path explicitly. The stopword list itself IS the recurrence-prevention mechanism for the false-positive class of bug -- extend only on future demonstrated failures, not preemptively (recorded as an explicit comment in context.ts).
